note:
ALA-LC Lao Romanization Table, 2012 version, pp. 1-3; held source interscript-private-references/alalc/alalc-lao.pdf. Extraction: PDF text layer (clean Unicode), every printed row cross-checked against rendered page images (200 dpi pages, 600-1400 dpi cell crops); the five obsolete-consonant vernacular cells (p2) and one vowel-table variant cell (p2 v8) carry no text-layer content in the source - they are pasted bitmap images (11-17 px) - and were identified visually.
Correction table (text layer -> print): the five obsolete vernacular cells are EMPTY in the text layer; identified by glyph skeleton against the Unicode 18.0 Lao chart and a Noto Sans Lao rendering: s = LAO LETTER SANSKRIT SHA U+0EA8, t = LAO LETTER PALI DDA U+0E91, t = LAO LETTER PALI DHA U+0E98, l = LAO LETTER PALI LLA U+0EAC (all four shape-confirmed), tsa = LAO LETTER SANSKRIT SSA U+0EA9 by set coherence (the printed values {s,t,t,tsa,l} = {śa,ḍa,ḍha,ṣa,ḷa}; L2/17-106 Table 1) - but the printed glyph's skeleton reads LAO LETTER PALI BHA U+0EA0 in modern fonts, so that identification is recorded as uncertain; the same five bitmaps appear unchanged in the LC 1997 scan (web.archive.org copy of loc.gov lao-1997.pdf). The v8 first variant is U+0EB9 itself rendered in a second font (no separate codepoint).
Findings (map-vs-source; transcribed rows EXCLUDED from the generated tests, never forced green; record for the maps-fix pipeline):
1. HO HIP ຫ (p1 row 25): printed initial value h has NO map rule; the map encodes only the Note-5 silent clusters (ຫຍ ຫນ ຫມ ຫຣ ຫລ ຫວ ຫຼ) and ຫ before a vowel passes through unchanged (ຫາ -> ຫā). H-initial syllables keep the Lao letter in the output.
2. The five obsolete consonants (p2, romanizations s/t/t/tsa/l): no map rules at all; ຨາ -> ຨā etc. (pass-through). Identifications as in the correction table.
3. Printed vowel rows the map lacks (the map composes neighbours instead): ເ◌ັ -> e (ກັ form composes kēa), ແ◌ັ -> æ (kǣa), ◌ົ -> o (ົ passes through), ◌ັອ -> ǫ (composes kaǭ), ◌ໍ -> ǭ (ໍ passes through), ◌ັຽ -> ia (composes kaຽ), ◌າຽ -> āi (ຽ passes through), ເ◌ົາ -> ao (the map's ົາ -> ao rule covers only the ເ-less form ກົາ, not the printed ເກົາ).
4. VALUE DIVERGENCE: printed ເ◌ັຽ -> īa; the map's ເັຽ rule outputs ia (ເກັຽ -> kia).
5. VALUE DIVERGENCE (Note 4): printed ◌ຽວ and ເ◌ັຽວ -> īeo; the map outputs kīao / kiao (ຽ -> īa, word-final ວ -> o).
6. ອ AS VOWEL (row v16): printed ◌ອ -> ǭ when not word-initial (Note 6); the map's from "ອ" to "ʻ" before boundary rule outputs ʻ for the bare letter. A stateless map cannot distinguish initial ອ (ʻ) from vowel ອ (ǭ); mid-word ອ -> ǭ works.
7. SPECIAL SYMBOLS: printed ໆ -> "(syllable repeated)" (a parenthetical description, not a romanization); the map encodes ໆ -> "...", kept as the existing encoding choice. Printed ຯ ລ ຯ -> la; the map composes "...l..." (no composite rule).
8. ຼ SUBSCRIPT LO LUT (Note 3): printed silent except after ຫ; the map has only ຫຼ -> l; bare ຼ passes through (ຄຼິສຕຽນ khitsatīan unreproducible; the map's hand test uses the ຼ-less spelling ຄິດສະຕຽນ).
9. METADATA INCONSISTENCY: the map description and notes block state that parenthesized (loan-only) final values "occur only in loans and keep the initial value" / "are not applied word-finally", but the encoded boundary rules DO apply them (ກາຂ -> kāk), matching the printed table. The rules match print; the note text is stale.
Bookkeeping: 125 rows transcribed; the rows array carries the 99 generated rows exactly (3 further passing rows duplicate the map's hand tests ຫຼາຍ lāi, ຫຍ້າ nyā, ອີກ ʻīk and are retained there; 2 passing duplicates of identical form are dropped, ກາ -> kā (row-1 initial = v2) and ໃກ -> kai (v25); 21 rows are the findings above, excluded from generation). Regenerating via scripts/gen-row-tests.mjs from this artifact reproduces the embedded block byte-for-byte.
